about: Authored prompt wrappers for Blocks T and L (written 2026-10-26, before any run). {placeholders} are filled by build_prompts.py with str.replace, never str.format.
nonce_rule: Driver-side: nonce = 4 groups of 3 digits, each group an element of NONCE_GROUPS (the 3-digit strings 000-999 that encode to exactly one token, sorted); group k = NONCE_GROUPS[int(sha256(f'{salt}:{seed}:{k}').hexdigest(), 16) % len(NONCE_GROUPS)]. The nonce line plus '\n' is prepended to the first user message. Its token count is constant (verified by build_prompts.py), so every prompt keeps its recorded length.
